mode_note: No live weather feed exists. The engine only ever emits HISTORICAL_REPLAY; it cannot pretend to be live.

data_status_template.cwc_available: CWC river level available ({stations} station(s) in cell)
data_status_template.cwc_missing: CWC river level UNAVAILABLE for this cell/date (reported as missing, not zero)

disclaimer: Zone risk score (0-100). HISTORICAL REPLAY/DEMO only - NOT a live prediction, NOT a flood probability, NOT an official warning.

ml_anomaly.rationale: Current hydrometeorological anomaly is the primary trigger signal.

temporal_intensity.source: rainfall_7d expanding-window percentile within the same grid (leak-safe)
temporal_intensity.rationale: Antecedent accumulation intensity relative to that zone's own history; complements the multivariate IF score without duplicating it exactly.
temporal_intensity.warmup_note: First 6 days per grid have incomplete 7-day windows (NaN in dataset); they are ranked as zero intensity - a documented warm-up approximation affecting 24 of 16072 rows.

vulnerability.rationale: Structural propensity modulates how strongly environmental signals translate into risk.

trend.note: delta = mean(risk[t-2..t]) - mean(risk[t-5..t-3]); >=10 -> STRONGLY_INCREASING; >=3 -> INCREASING; >-3 -> STABLE; else DECREASING. Undefined until both windows exist.

future_lstm_interface.contract: any temporal model producing a 0-100 signal per (date, grid_id) can substitute the anomaly weight source without changing Modules 1/3/4/5 or ViaSocket
